house_c_resident.text: Come in, pet. You can smell the chocolate on the wind, can you not? York is the city of sweets.
Rowntree's made Kit Kat here. It began in 1935 as a Chocolate Crisp, and got the name in 1937.
Terry's of York made the Chocolate Orange in 1932. Tap it and unwrap it, and it falls apart into segments like a real orange.
My bairn feeds the starlets crumbs from the window. At dusk they gather in the thousands, and it is lovely.
